title: Suspect Drives Through Front Yards and Crashes into Fence During Police Pursuit
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Oklahoma City, Oklahoma — On August 18, 2025, around 1 a.m. an Oklahoma City Police Officer spotted a car making turns without signaling near N. Highland Drive and Northeast 16th Street. The driver, later identified as  62-year-old Donald Ray, refused to stop after the officer activated his emergency lights, instead running a stop sign and accelerating to 65 mph through residential streets. The first TVI caused Ray’s car to spin out and crash into a parked vehicle, but he continued fleeing by driving through multiple front yards and even onto a sidewalk before police attempted a second maneuver. The pursuit came to an end when Ray’s vehicle struck a fence behind a local credit union.

When officers approached the car, they discovered a female passenger who told police she was not willingly involved in the chase and claimed Ray had thrown a gun out of the window during the pursuit. Although a firearm was not recovered, officers did find methamphetamine in Ray’s pocket. He was taken into custody and booked into the Oklahoma County Jail on numerous charges including: Endangering Others While Eluding Police Officer, Speeding, Leaving Scene of an Accident Involving Damage, Driving with License Canceled, Suspended or Revoked, Possession of Controlled Substance, Failure to Signal on Turning, Failure to Stop at Stop Sign. According to police records, Ray has a prior criminal history, including a 2016 conviction for bringing contraband into a jail.
